[NFCT.6.4] **Looking a fact up by id.** `ds_engine_fact_find(e, fact_id,
&out)` answers whether the fact with that id ([NFCT.6.2]'s `ds_fact_get_id`)
is still live. If it is, the call returns `DS_OK` with `*out` set to it, a
pointer with [NFCT.5.3]'s lifetime. If no live fact has the id — it was
retracted, expired, superseded, or never assigned — the call returns
`DS_ERR_NOT_FOUND` and sets `*out` to `NULL`.

An id is never reassigned, so a caller holding only an id can tell whether its
fact is still live without mirroring the stream: look it up, then retract the
pointer the lookup returned ([NFCT.3.1]). The lookup reads working memory, so a
halted engine refuses it with `DS_ERR_ENGINE_HALTED` ([NCBK.2.9]).
